subject.title: fix(nvidia): sync recommended models with featured catalog

question: Should this PR preserve every NVIDIA model ref shipped in `v2026.6.11` as deprecated exact-reference fallback rows, or may it intentionally drop the remaining stale refs?
rationale: Provider fallback and model-choice behavior are compatibility-sensitive, and the current diff changes the offline/static fallback contract for upgraded NVIDIA users without visible maintainer approval.

options.title: Preserve all shipped refs
options.body: Add deprecated compatibility rows for the omitted shipped refs while keeping them hidden from selectable picker/setup surfaces.

options.title: Accept narrower fallback
options.body: Merge the feed-only fallback policy only with explicit maintainer approval plus upgrade-impact documentation.

options.title: Pause for provider policy
options.body: Hold the PR until the NVIDIA/provider owner confirms the permanent fallback compatibility boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve all shipped refs
recommendation.body: Add deprecated compatibility rows for the omitted shipped refs while keeping them hidden from selectable picker/setup surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider onboarding/catalog work plus the protected label make this the best available owner for the compatibility-risk decision.
